spec.name: Blend v36
spec.notes: Blend of trend, earnings surprise and a volatility penalty.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.4, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 9%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy shows a high Sharpe ratio, but the research log indicates that this is one of only two trials performed. While the strategy logic is sound and incorporates reasonable cost assumptions, the small sample size of the research process suggests a risk of selection bias. The performance claims may be inflated due to the limited number of iterations. I recommend paper trading to verify that the signal holds up in live market conditions before committing real capital.
